id.title: Id
id.description: The id of the step. Assigned by the database.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The surface that this agent step was initiated from.

provider_id.title: Provider Id
provider_id.description: The unique identifier of the provider that was configured for this step

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: The unique identifier of the run that this step belongs to. Only included for async calls.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The ID of the agent that performed the step.

provider_name.title: Provider Name
provider_name.description: The name of the provider used for this step.

provider_category.title: Provider Category
provider_category.description: The category of the provider used for this step.

model.title: Model
model.description: The name of the model used for this step.

model_handle.title: Model Handle
model_handle.description: The model handle (e.g., 'openai/gpt-4o-mini') used for this step.

model_endpoint.title: Model Endpoint
model_endpoint.description: The model endpoint url used for this step.

context_window_limit.title: Context Window Limit
context_window_limit.description: The context window limit configured for this step.

completion_tokens.title: Completion Tokens
completion_tokens.description: The number of tokens generated by the agent during this step.

prompt_tokens.title: Prompt Tokens
prompt_tokens.description: The number of tokens in the prompt during this step.

total_tokens.title: Total Tokens
total_tokens.description: The total number of tokens processed by the agent during this step.

cached_input_tokens.title: Cached Input Tokens
cached_input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens served from cache. None if not reported by provider.

cache_write_tokens.title: Cache Write Tokens
cache_write_tokens.description: The number of input tokens written to cache (Anthropic only). None if not reported by provider.

reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning Tokens
reasoning_tokens.description: The number of reasoning/thinking tokens generated. None if not reported by provider.

prompt_tokens_details.title: Prompt Tokens Details
prompt_tokens_details.description: Detailed prompt token breakdown (e.g., cached_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens).

stop_reason.description: The stop reason associated with the step.

tid.title: Tid
tid.description: The unique identifier of the transaction that processed this step.

trace_id.title: Trace Id
trace_id.description: The trace id of the agent step.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: The API request log ID from cloud-api for correlating steps with API requests.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The messages generated during this step. Deprecated: use `GET /v1/steps/{step_id}/messages` endpoint instead

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: The feedback for this step. Must be either 'positive' or 'negative'.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: The project that the agent that executed this step belongs to (cloud only).

error_type.title: Error Type
error_type.description: The type/class of the error that occurred

error_data.title: Error Data
error_data.description: Error details including message, traceback, and additional context

status.description: Step status: pending, success, or failed
